relations.subject: Gaṅgānātha Jhā
relations.evidence: He passed the Entrance, (i. e., the Matriculation) examination in 1886... and then joined the Queen's College at Varanasi

relations.subject: Gaṅgānātha Jhā
relations.evidence: He passed the Intermediate Examination in 1888, in the first division, standing eleventh in the list of successful candidate of the Calcutta University

relations.subject: Gaṅgānātha Jhā
relations.evidence: In 1890, he graduated by taking the B. A. degree, standing first in the Allahabad University, with honours in philosophy

relations.subject: Gaṅgānātha Jhā
relations.evidence: In 1893, Dr. Jha was appointed Librarian of the Darbhangā Rāj Library... He remained, in charge of the Raj Library, at Darbhanga, till 1902.

relations.subject: Gaṅgānātha Jhā
relations.evidence: In 1902, Dr. Jha resigned the post of the Librarian, at Darbhanga, and came to Allahabad as Professor of Sanskrit, at the Muir Central College.

relations.subject: G. Thibaut
relations.evidence: Dr. Thibaut, a very distinguished Sanskrit scholar, who was the then Principal of the College

relations.subject: Gaṅgānātha Jhā
relations.evidence: In 1907, he began to edit, with the co-operation of Dr. Thibaut, a learned quarterly journal called "Indian Thought"

meta.title: Journal of the Ganganatha Jha Kendriya Sanskrit Vidyapeetha
